recommend.title: Rust shared core + host adapter
why: Keeps domain logic independent from the Cloudflare-specific adapter.
Makes the same core usable from Worker, CLI, desktop/native, and tests.

recommend.title: Rust/Wasm signed-request Worker
why: The workload is bounded request-time work.
The template starts with HMAC verification and constant-time comparison.

recommend.title: Rust/Wasm typed data processor
why: Typed deterministic transforms fit bounded edge execution.

recommend.title: Cloudflare Worker
alternatives: TypeScript for ordinary web/API ecosystem integration.
Rust/Wasm `api` template when Rust typing/native-core reuse is valuable.

recommend.title: Normal service/container runtime
why: Long-running work is a poor fit for a short-lived Worker isolate.
Normal services support broader OS/process/runtime assumptions.

recommend.title: Native process or container
why: The workload requires capabilities that generic WebAssembly Workers should not be assumed to provide.

recommend.title: Tauri-style TypeScript UI + Rust native boundary
why: TypeScript suits the application/UI layer while Rust owns native device capabilities.

recommend.title: TypeScript/browser application
why: The browser and AgentSam UI/package ecosystem are TypeScript-first.
